name: Cult of the Four-Armed Emperor
source: Mord Hive v0.5, pp.078-082 (Cult of the Four-Armed Emperor - a Genestealer Cult). Statlines from datasheets pp.079-080; equipment lists p.079; Blessings of the Four-Armed Emperor p.081; Cult Rituals p.082 (see spells.json). Hero/henchman split follows the starting-experience lines (Magus 20, Anointed 8, Hybrid Acolytes 0 as Heroes; Cult Initiates / Hybrid Neophytes / Aberrants as Henchmen). NOTE: p.078 says up to two Hybrid Acolytes while the p.080 datasheet header reads '0-3' - the choice-of-warriors limit (2) is used here. exclusiveEquipment.name: Chain Weapon
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Any melee weapon upgraded to a Chain Weapon (Hero only): +1 to Injury Rolls, strikes at -1 Initiative. Costs 3x the base weapon price.

specialRules: Cult of the Four-Armed Emperor (a Genestealer Cult). Blessings of the Four-Armed Emperor (bought for a Hybrid Acolyte or Anointed on recruitment only, never later; first at listed price, second and subsequent for the same model cost double): Shadow in the Warp (4+ save vs psychic powers/prayers, 20 tn), Rending Claw (no weapon in that arm; extra attack at +1 Strength, 50 tn), Fleet of Claw (+1 Movement, 40 tn), Spine Shield (obstruct an opponent to reduce his attacks by -1, min 1, 35 tn), Acid Blood (on losing a wound in close combat, models in base contact suffer a S3 hit, no crits, 30 tn), Spines (models in base contact suffer an automatic S1 hit at the start of each close combat phase, no crits, 35 tn), Prehensile Stinger (extra S5 attack each combat phase; S2 vs poison-immune, 40 tn), Extra Arm (use a single-handed weapon for +1 attack, or carry a shield/buckler; an Anointed gains the extra attack but still can't carry a weapon, 40 tn), Nightmarish Form (causes fear, 40 tn). | Worker-Stock Equipment List prices Heavy Stubber at 60 tn (the shared chart lists 50). Chain Weapon costs 3x the weapon price (Hero only). | Min warband size 3, max 15. Anointed are Genestealers (null ceilings; never advance toward a human max).
